subject: English
passage:
The following text is adapted from Julian Alvarez's 2019 short story "The Mentor."

I wish I could remember those first words,

First lesson, first moment of your teaching me,

If harsh or gentle your approach might be

Fall or Spring semester, nothing occurs;

So carelessly did I let it pass by,

So foolish was I to listen and learn,

So slow to grasp the wisdom you would share

That would not take root until years went by.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: The speaker celebrates how the passage of time has strengthened a mentorship that once seemed ordinary.
choices.B: Because the speaker did not anticipate how important a mentor's guidance would become, he cannot recall how the mentorship began, which he regrets.
choices.C: As the anniversary of meeting an important mentor approaches, the speaker feels uncertain about how best to honor the relationship.
choices.D: After years of ignoring a once meaningful mentorship, the speaker worries it may be too late for him to repair the relationship.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The speaker says that he wishes he could remember when he first learned from someone, but he can't remember those early lessons at all, because he didn't know at the time that the wisdom would 'take root' later on.
